services.name: Weeki Wachee Kayaking
services.desc: Enjoy a day in paradise paddling one of Florida's most pristine spring fed rivers! About Say hello to one of the most beautiful rivers Florida has to offer. The Weeki Wachee River has an average flow rate of 112 million gallons of crystal clear spring water per day, year round water temperatures ranging from 72F to 74F, and frequent manatee visitors. We feel pretty safe saying this river redefines the definition of paradise. We launch you from our launch point. Paddle up the river as far as you'd like to explore. When you're finished, paddle back down to our launch point. All day until 5! For all ages! • Rent our boats or bring your own!

includes: Life vest and paddles included with every river trip
Dry bags available upon request, limited number
blurb: Guests paddle on the Weeki Wachee River, a spring-fed river with year-round water temperatures of 72F to 74F and frequent manatee visitors. They launch from a private dock and can paddle as far as they like with no hourly time limits, returning by 5:00 PM. Life vests, paddles, and dry bags (limited, on request) are included.
